cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

time.sleep(8)

# Check status
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list")
print("PM2:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check ports
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep node")
print("\nPorts:", stdout.read().decode())

# Test site
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s https://arelorian.de/ | head -2")
print("\nSite:", stdout.read().decode()[:80])

client.close()
EOF
